items.title: 68091_Joe Turner oral history interview
items.q: I run up on a fellow named Ferguson, had a bookin' agency. So I got hung up with him.

ctx.x: Carnegie Hall in New York City, I went back to Cafe Society, while we were workin' there, and I stayed there so long until that I was one of the fixtures in the place, so I finally took off and went to Indianapolis.

I run up on a fellow named Ferguson, had a bookin' agency. So I got hung up with him. So he had a band out of Philadelphia-- a bunch of young kids called Little Bo's (?) Band. And we was, uh... we got together. They could play all that Count Basie, Duke Ellington an' ever'body. Had a little bit o' ever'body music in their band. Bunch o' young kids. So I toured all over the South with 'em, all of em' up North 'n' everywhere with 'em. We had us a ball.

So's we's in Kansas...went back to Kansas City, an' I was in a hotel--the Lincoln Hotel, there. We sittin' around and havin' a few drinks with a bunch of my old-time friends. They sent me a girl singer called Sheila Guys (?). I had never seen her before. So they called me on the phone, tol' me there was a lady downstairs wantsta sing with the band and for me to come downstairs.
